Based on the search results, I found comprehensive information about StableMoE:

## Overview
The Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) technique can scale up the model size of Transformers with an affordable computational overhead.

## The Routing Fluctuation Problem
Existing learning-to-route MoE methods suffer from the routing fluctuation issue, i.e., the target expert of the same input may change along with training, but only one expert will be activated for the input during inference. The routing fluctuation tends to harm sample efficiency because the same input updates different experts but only one is finally used.

## StableMoE Solution
The paper proposes StableMoE with two training stages to address the routing fluctuation problem. In the first training stage, they learn a balanced and cohesive routing strategy and distill it into a lightweight router decoupled from the backbone model. In the second training stage, they utilize the distilled router to determine the token-to-expert assignment and freeze it for a stable routing strategy.

## Results
The method is validated on language modeling and multilingual machine translation, with results showing that StableMoE outperforms existing MoE methods in terms of both convergence speed and performance.

## Publication Details
The paper was published in the Proceedings of the 60th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers) in 2022 by Damai Dai, Li Dong, Shuming Ma, Bo Zheng, Zhifang Sui, Baobao Chang, and Furu Wei.
